intent: Close the stdout-capture bug class in the shell scripts. ps_resolve_port_interactive writes its entire UI to stdout inside $( ), so the banner is captured as the PORT value and .env.local becomes multi-line prose. The corruption is STICKY: ps_env_set de-dups with grep -v '^KEY=', which cannot remove the orphan lines it wrote. QA hit this on a clean bootstrap and it blocked all downstream testing; their fix (prompts to stderr, printf the value) is correct but is unpushed and not in this tree, so reproduce it here. Then close the class: add the missing ps_validate_port_number guard after the interactive branch (the non-interactive branch already validates); harden ps_env_set and setup.mjs's setEnvLocal against multi-line values; fix resolve_python, which calls exit 1 inside a function only ever run in $( ) so the failure exits the subshell and the script continues with an empty interpreter path; and document that ps_info/ps_ok/ps_step/ps_dim all write to stdout while only ps_warn/ps_err use stderr, which is the standing landmine. Interactive setup has NO test: the shell harness only runs bash -n and its file list does not even include ps-port.sh. Source: the operator's live Hermes QA pass on dev@43d16c30, 2026-08-26. Root cause traced by three read-only investigations and re-verified independently; NOT a regression from the consolidation work, which only put a QA pass in front of pages nobody had text-scraped before.
